question: Could you tell me the number of orders, average payment per order and customer lifespan in weeks of the 3 custumers with the highest average payment per order, where the lifespan is calculated by subtracting the earliest purchase date from the latest purchase date in days, dividing by seven, and if the result is less than seven days, setting it to 1.0?
sql:
WITH customer_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        SUM(op.payment_value) as total_payment,
        COUNT(op.payment_value) as payment_count
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
customer_avg_payment AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        total_payment / payment_count as avg_payment_per_order
    FROM customer_payments
),
top_3_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM customer_avg_payment
    ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
customer_order_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(*) as num_orders,
        AVG(op.payment_value) as avg_payment_per_order,
        MIN(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS date)) as earliest_purchase,
        MAX(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS date)) as latest_purchase
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    cos.customer_id,
    cos.num_orders,
    cos.avg_payment_per_order,
    CASE 
        WHEN (CAST(cos.latest_purchase AS date) - CAST(cos.earliest_purchase AS date)) < 7 
        THEN 1.0 
        ELSE (CAST(cos.latest_purchase AS date) - CAST(cos.earliest_purchase AS date)) / 7 
    END as lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_order_stats cos
JOIN top_3_customers t3 ON cos.customer_id = t3.customer_id
ORDER BY cos.avg_payment_per_order DESC
